model.title: Holocaust Education and Antisemitism Lessons Act
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. Jacklyn Rosen (D-NV)

summary.text: The bill would direct the U.S. Holocaust Memorial Museum to study and report on how Holocaust education is handled in states, local school districts, and public elementary and secondary schools. The study would examine whether states and districts require Holocaust education in the curriculum, what standards and requirements apply to it, and what kinds of teaching materials are used to teach students about the Holocaust.
